svg.title: Proportional position control of the shaft
svg.desc: With Kp 16 the shaft reaches 1 radian at 0.46 seconds moving 3.29 radians per second, peaks at 1.72 radians and is still 0.19 radians off after 4 seconds; with Kp 4 it peaks at 1.46 radians and is 0.10 radians off. Neither meets the 1.1 radian peak or the 0.02 radian band.
svg.text: Proportional position control of the shaft
Control Studio validation runs on the actual ST · 1 rad step · 20 ms samples · numbers answer the predictions
Reaches 1 rad at 0.46 s, still moving 3.29 rad/s
Still 0.19 rad off after 4 s (Kp 4: 0.10 rad);
